title: Time in a Bottle
description:
This item allows you to accelerate the rate at which blocks tick. It passively collects time while in your inventory (20 ticks of stored time every second, in any inventory slot) which you can consume by right clicking a block with it. The tooltip shows the stored time as hours, minutes and seconds.

The first click on a block creates a time accelerator there for 30 seconds and costs 30 seconds of stored time. Each further click on the same block doubles the speed (2x, 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x) and costs 30, 60, 120, 240 and 480 seconds respectively, so reaching 32x takes six clicks. Upgrading also extends the remaining duration. At 32x further clicks do nothing. If the bottle does not hold enough time, a red message is shown. Creative players pay nothing.

The accelerator ticks tile entities (furnaces, hoppers and similar blocks) extra times and gives other blocks additional random ticks. If you carry several bottles, only the one with the most stored time keeps its time. The bottle also feeds the Eclipsed Clock.
